key.name: ocgo-path
key.description: Absolute path (or command name) of the ocgo CLI. Empty means auto-detect: ~/.local/bin/ocgo first, then the PATH.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the extension triggers "ocgo refresh".

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Top-bar zone for the indicator: left, center, or right. Values outside that set fall back to right in the extension code.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: 0 is first in the zone; -1 appends the indicator last.
